name: scene_batch_8
title: Card scenes, batch 8
intro: Keep or reject each scene, in the C and E mix. Each tile is the bare scene over two real cards, a program or event and a building, composed at 300 dpi with the full bleed showing: the program window is the whole scene, the building window its center. Scenes are a pool: the card a scene was written for is a suggestion. The second card only shows the other window. For true size, print art-originals/scenes/b8/cards.pdf at 100%. Use the notes for what to change.

rows.label: 1. Industry: A vast modern fabrication megaplex seen from a high gantry, rows of robotic assembly cells under a long sawtooth roof running to the far wall, conveyor lines carrying finished parts and trays of green circuit chips, small workers on the floor below; no flags or emblems.
rows.note: Written for Fabrication Megaplex. Shown on Antitrust Action and Fabrication Megaplex. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 2. Science: A brand-new frontier research lab of glass and white steel opening on a hilltop campus, scientists in lab coats carrying the first crates of glowing sky-blue research cubes through its tall doors while a founder holds up a blank rolled charter to a small cheering crowd; no flags or emblems.
rows.note: Written for Frontier Lab Charter. Shown on Frontier Lab Charter and Citation Engine. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 3. Power: A national power grid being built across open country, crews and cranes raising a long line of new lattice pylons over farmland toward the horizon, cable drums on trucks, three fresh substations taking shape along the route, a power station far off; no flags or emblems.
rows.note: Written for National Grid Buildout. Shown on National Grid Buildout and Grid Analytics Desk. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 4. Security: A security team in coral-trimmed tactical gear storming a hijacked rooftop server hub in daylight, one pulling the thick cables from a glowing cold-blue machine core while others lead a line of dark-suited adversary envoys away, figures seen from behind; no flags or emblems.
rows.note: Written for Decapitation Strike. Shown on Decapitation Strike and Agency Directorate. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.
